version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

estimates.description:
Estimates in raw data. key is YEAR-MONTH

@db(storage="column")

missing.description:
Value indicating if the interval is missing or not. null value represents all available
Key is the same as counts / values

values.description:
Value is all normalized points that fall into this period. key is grain-YEAR-MONTH.

@db(storage="columnPerKey")

range.description: Contains the range of this timeseries. start, end, finest-grain at which the timeseries is normalized

state.description:
This object contains meta information about how the timeseries was normalized and if there
were any errors during normalization.

valid.description: Denotes whether the given timeseries is valid and ready for consumption

earliestLatestValue.description:
The value for earliest and latest data point for this timeseries. It is extracted from the raw data
This is independent of interval, time period, etc.
Pair contains -> <Earliest Value, Latest Value>

counts.description:
Value is all raw data point counts that fall into this period. key is grain-YEAR-MONTH.

@db(storage="columnPerKey")

invalidatedRanges.description:
Time range indicating the period that is invalidated. The presence of this field means that the state is invalid
This field will be stored a they arrive and will only be gettable by it self without using include with other fields

title:
Data type for storing normalized timeseries data. One NormalizedTimeseries object is created
per header-field combination
name: NormalizedTimeseries
